{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}}
{{Use American English|date=November 2025}}
Group L of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] took place from June 17 to 27, 2026.<ref name="match schedule">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref> The group consisted of [[England national football team|England]], [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]], and [[Panama national football team|Panama]].

England finished as group leaders, with Croatia finishing as runners-up after crucial victories against Panama and Ghana in their subsequent two group games. Thus, both teams advanced to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]].

Ghana finished in third place, and were able to advance as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|top eight third-place teams]]. Panama lost all three group games without scoring a goal, thus making them the first national team to not score in a World Cup<ref name="regulations">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref> since [[Honduras national football team|Honduras]] in [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010]].

Additionally, it was England’s first World Cup ever played on U.S. soil after missing out the [[1994 FIFA World Cup|1994]] edition.<ref>{{cite web |last=Hopkins |first=Jessica |title= England qualify for the 2026 World Cup: Who could they play and when is the draw? |url= https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6713062/2025/10/14/england-2026-fifa-world-cup/ |access-date= 14 October 2025|work=[[The Athletic]] |date= 14 October 2025}}</ref>

==Standings==
{{2026 FIFA World Cup group tables|Group L}}

In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]:<ref name="regulations"/>
* The winner of Group L, [[England national football team|England]], advanced to play the third-place team of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[DR Congo national football team|DR Congo]].
* The runner-up of Group L, [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], advanced to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]].
* The third-place team of Group L, [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]], as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]] from the group stage.

==Matches==
All times listed are local.<ref name="match schedule"/>

===England vs Croatia===
The teams had previously met in eleven previous matches, including a [[2018 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Croatia vs England|2–1 semi-final win]] in [[2018 FIFA World Cup|2018]] for Croatia to advance to their [[2018 FIFA World Cup final|first final]].<ref>{{cite web|title=England vs. Croatia Head-to-Head in the World Cups|url=https://www.thesoccerworldcups.com/head_to_head/england_vs_croatia.php|website=The Soccer World Cups|access-date=6 December 2025}}</ref> Their most recent meeting was in the [[UEFA Euro 2020]] group stage, with England winning [[UEFA Euro 2020 Group D#England vs Croatia|1–0]].<ref>{{cite web|title=England national football team: record v Croatia|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/england/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Croatia|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref>

In the 12th minute, England were awarded a penalty after [[Luka Modric]] fouled [[Noni Madueke]] with a kick inside the penalty area. [[Harry Kane]] took the penalty which was saved down low to his left by Croatian goalkeeper [[Dominik Livaković]]. The penalty had to be re-taken as Livaković was judged to have moved off his line before it was kicked, Kane again took the penalty and scored into the right of the net to put England into a 1–0 lead. In the 36th minute [[Martin Baturina]] made it 1–1 with a right foot shot to the top left corner of the net from outside the penalty area on the right which England goalkeeper [[Jordan Pickford]] got a hand to but couldn't prevent from going into the net. In the 42nd minute, England went back in front when Kane headed to the left of the net after making a run to meet a corner from the right by [[Declan Rice]]. With his second goal, Kane equalled [[Gary Lineker]]’s goals record for [[England at the FIFA World Cup|England at the World Cup]] with 10 goals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/harry-kane-world-cup-goals-gary-lineker-england-croatia-b2997929.html|title= Harry Kane equals all-time England World Cup record after first-half double against Croatia|date=17 June 2026|work=The Independent |accessdate=18 June 2026}}</ref>
Five minutes later it was 2–2 when [[Petar Musa]] fired to the net from the left inside the penalty area after a header back to him from [[Ivan Perišić]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jun/17/england-croatia-world-cup-2026-group-l-match-report|title= England surge to thrilling opening win in World Cup cracker with Croatia|date=17 June 2026|work=Guardian |accessdate=18 June 2026}}</ref>

England went back in front, two minutes into the second half when [[Jude Bellingham]] received the ball on the right before cutting in and shooting right footed low to the left corner of the net from the right of the penalty area. It was 4–2 in the 85th minute when substitute [[Marcus Rashford]] received the ball on the left of the penalty area before cutting in on his right foot and shooting low to the right corner of the net.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cp36z3qpzrxt|title= England 4 Croatia 2|date=17 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=18 June 2026}}</ref>

===Ghana vs Panama===
The two teams had never met before.

In the 95th minute, [[Caleb Yirenkyi]] got the winning goal with a close range finish after a low cross by [[Brandon Thomas-Asante]] from the left, securing a 1–0 win and becoming the second-youngest player to score for Ghana at a World Cup behind [[Haminu Draman]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Rindl |first=Joe |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c9d259zxxn7t |title=Ghana 1–0 Panama |publisher=BBC Sport |date=17 June 2026 }}</ref><ref name=":0" /> The 95th minute strike was also Ghana's latest ever goal scored in regulation time at a World Cup.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=King |first=Oliver |date=17 June 2026 |title=Ghana 1–0 Panama Stats: Yirenkyi's Last-Gasp Winner Snatches Priceless Group L Win |url=https://theanalyst.com/articles/ghana-vs-panama-stats-world-cup-2026 |access-date=17 June 2026 |website=theanalyst.com |language=en}}</ref>

===England vs Ghana===
[[File:Harry Kane 9 England v Ghana at 2026 Fifa World Cup by YantsImages 06.jpg|thumb|right|During the match between England and Ghana]]
England had previously faced Ghana only once, a 1–1 friendly draw in 2011.<ref>{{cite web|title=England national football team: record v Ghana|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/england/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Ghana|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref>

In a game of few chances, in the 66th minute [[Jordan Pickford]] collided with [[Prince Kwabena Adu]] outside the penalty area with a free awarded to Pickford.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/england-ghana-world-cup-2026-result-b3001698.html|title= Dismal England serve up World Cup Shocker to highlight old problem|date=23 June 2026|work=The Independent |accessdate=24 June 2026}}</ref>

In the 78th minute Ghana had a potential penalty not awarded, [[Ezri Konsa]] dived in to challenge Prince Kwabena Adu in the penalty area, bringing him down without making any contact with the ball.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cx2j74xqy7jt|title= England 0 Ghana 0|date=23 June 2026|work=BBC Sport |accessdate=24 June 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cd6e3gvnnzwo|title='VAR went for a coffee' – should Ghana have had penalty against England?|date=22 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=24 June 2026}}</ref>
[[Bukayo Saka]] had a low shot from the right saved by Ghana goalkeeper [[Benjamin Asare]]. [[Nico O'Reilly]] also headed against the bar from six yards out after a cross from [[Marcus Rashford]] from the right with [[Harry Kane]] shooting the rebound over the bar, with the match finishing 0–0.

===Panama vs Croatia===
The two teams had never met before.

[[Luka Modrić]] made his 200th appearance for Croatia in his fifth World Cup, becoming the [[List of men's footballers with 100 or more international caps|fourth player]] to reach that number.

In the 54th minute, [[Ante Budimir]] scored the only goal of the game for Croatia when he finished at the back post from five yards out after a low cross from [[Josip Stanišić]] on the right.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c0ly4w636l3t|title= Panama 0 Croatia 1|date=23 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=24 June 2026}}</ref> With this defeat, Panama were eliminated from the tournament.

===Panama vs England===
[[File:Amir Murillo Marcus Rashford England v Panama 27 June 26-079.jpg|thumb|right|Action between England and Panama in the second half]]
The teams had only met once before, when England defeated debutant Panama [[2018 FIFA World Cup Group G#England vs Panama|6–1]] in a group stage match of the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Panama national football team: record v England|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/panama/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/England|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref>

In the 62nd minute, England went in front when [[Jude Bellingham]] scored, hooking the ball into the left of the net from six yards out after a corner from the left by [[Bukayo Saka]]. Five minutes later it was 2–0 when [[Harry Kane]] headed to the left of the net from six yards out after a cross by Bellingham from the left.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cq5186pg2qqt|title= Panama 0 England 2|date=27 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=13 October 2026}}</ref>

With three additional defeats, Panama now has six overall losses from its two World Cup appearances, remaining winless in its return after [[2018 FIFA World Cup|8 years]], and left the tournament as the only team that failed to score a goal.

==Discipline==
The team conduct ("fair play") score would have been used as a tiebreaker if the head-to-head and overall records of teams were tied. It would also be used as a tiebreaker for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|third-place ranking]] between groups if the overall records of teams were tied. The score was calculated based on yellow and red cards received by players and team officials in all group matches as follows:<ref name="regulations"/>
*yellow card: −1 point;
*indirect red card (second yellow card): −3 points;
*direct red card: −4 points;
*yellow card and direct red card: −5 points;

Only one of the above deductions could be applied to a player or team official in a single match.
